reason: I do not know this website or the people behind it, and I would have to give it my resume and my data before I know if it helps. I already follow one YouTuber's free roadmap, so I see no reason to pay 299 a month for something I cannot yet see working.
objection: I do not trust a new website with my resume and my data. Nothing here tells me how my data is stored or used, and the hidden-test feature that would make it worth paying for is not even available yet.
would_change_my_mind: A free check that shows my real resume gaps and a plan built from what I have proven, with a clear note on what happens to my resume and data, before I pay anything.
